'''Let's Fight for the Future!!''' (Japanese: '''ともに戦おう!!　未来のために''' ''Let's Battle Together!! For the Future'') is the twenty-third and final chapter of the [[Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* The [[Black Tyranitar]] destroys the [[Cianwood Gym]].
* {{TP|Gold|Pikachu}} begins fading away, as the appearance of the Black Tyranitar threatens to alter the future.
* {{GnB|Gold}}, [[Chuck]], and [[Eusine]] attack the Black Tyranitar together, but are easily defeated.
* [[Jasmine]] and the Trainers from [[Olivine City]] arrive to help.
* The Black Tyranitar tries to escape to Olivine City, but is stopped by {{p|Lugia}}.
* Gold tries to capture the Black Tyranitar with his [[Level Ball]], but fails.
* With {{GnB|Black}}'s support, Gold successfully captures and seals the Black Tyranitar away once again.
* Gold and {{GnB|Chris}} continue their journey together.
